EmailTemplate.subject: $10 Gift Card + Extra Benefit for March Donors!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
[NAME]
Your blood drive is coming up, and every donation is vital because hospital patients are counting on lifesaving blood products from your drive. We are grateful for your kindness and commitment to helping those in need.
Diabetes impacts over 38 million people in the United States, and nearly one-quarter do not know they have it. The hemoglobin A1C test is commonly used to screen for prediabetes and diabetes, both serious but treatable conditions. We know you care about helping patients in need. We want you and your donors to know how much we care about them by expanding our health offerings to include free A1C testing for all who successfully give blood at your March blood drive.^ We’re also showing our thanks with a $10 Amazon.com Gift Card** by email when donors come to give March 1-31.*
As you continue the work to make your drive a success – remember to use these tips:
Share the attached email about these exciting incentives to recruit more blood donors! Fill your schedule. Use these tools to recruit blood donors and schedule them using the Blood Drive Management Portal. Encourage donors to schedule a donation for a friend. Each additional donor scheduled means more lives saved!
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out – I’m always here to help!
IMPORTANT: Donors MUST have a valid email address on file to receive their Gift Card.
All the best,
[NAME]
^The American Red Cross will offer hemoglobin A1C (A1C) testing, commonly used to screen for prediabetes and diabetes, to all donors who successfully give blood, platelets or plasma March 1-31, 2025. Donors will need to have a successful donation to receive A1C results, because only successful donations are sent to our laboratory for testing. Donors will only receive a test result on their first donation during the testing period. Results will be available in one (1) to two (2) weeks through the Red Cross Blood Donor App or a donor’s account at RedCrossBlood.org. If a donor does not wish to have their donation tested for A1C, they are encouraged to make an appointment before or after testing will be offered in March. More information about diabetes and A1C testing is available at RedCrossBlood.org/diabetes.
**Restrictions apply, see amazon.com/gc-legal.
*Presenting donors who receive this offer and present to donate during the applicable promotional time frame are eligible to receive the above described e-gift card(s). This offer is non-transferable and not redeemable for cash. Limit one (1) per presenting donor unless otherwise indicated. If a presenting donor qualifies for multiple offers, the donor will only receive the higher offer unless otherwise indicated. Instructions on how to redeem the gift card will be emailed to the address listed on the presenting donor’s American Red Cross donor profile approximately thirty (30) days after attempted donation(s). All gift cards are subject to individual merchant terms and conditions, and all trademarks are property of their respective owners. Merchants and offers are subject to change. No substitutions by presenting donors. American Red Cross is not responsible for lost, damaged, corrupted or stolen gift cards and may replace any such cards at its sole discretion. Any questions or problems in connection with redeeming gift cards must be directed to the merchant.
